_doc: Samāsa vigrahas from our 2026-10-25 split-gap and 2026-10-26 whole-compound runs, for compounds in Sri Tamal Maharaj's bhāṣya-word data, keyed by his surface forms; p/g quoted from his deposit (CC BY 4.0). A form is here when the first (whole-compound) layer of every card that shows it comes from one of those two runs. Each vigraha entry = exactly what our reading card shows (reviewed wrong layers and layers about other words excluded, duplicate lines folded), with the full layers recovered from the stored peel and the run that produced it (`source`). `part` = the stored key, set when a card joins several stored peels (fused token / multi-part). `shownIn` = the texts whose cards show that variant, when cards differ by text. `stripped` = members the 10-25 run returned that do not occur in the compound (removed). Machine-made; not scholar-reviewed. Generated from the deployed academy build.
